Callbacks

class callbacks.Callback[source]

Bases: object

Base callback with no-op implementations of all training hooks.

Subclass and override the relevant methods to inject behaviour at specific points in the training loop.

on_epoch_fi(logs_dict, model, epoch, **kwargs)[source]

Called at the end of each epoch.

Parameters:

  • logs_dict (dict) – Validation metrics for the finished epoch.

  • model (nn.Module) – The model being trained.

  • epoch (int) – Current epoch index.

on_epoch_init(model, epoch, **kwargs)[source]

Called at the start of each epoch.

Parameters:

  • model (nn.Module) – The model being trained.

  • epoch (int) – Current epoch index.

on_step_fi(logs_dict, model, epoch, **kwargs)[source]

Called at the end of each optimisation step.

Parameters:

  • logs_dict (dict) – Metrics produced during the step.

  • model (nn.Module) – The model being trained.

  • epoch (int) – Current epoch index.

on_step_init(logs_dict, model, epoch, **kwargs)[source]

Called at the start of each optimisation step.

on_train_fi(model, **kwargs)[source]

Called once after training finishes.

on_train_init(model, **kwargs)[source]

Called once before training begins.

class callbacks.ModelCheckpoint(dirpath, save_model_frequency)[source]

Bases: Callback

Save model (and optimizer) state at the end of every epoch.

Always writes model_checkpoint.LAST.pth and additionally writes model_checkpoint.<epoch>.pth every save_model_frequency epochs. On training completion writes model_checkpoint.FI.pth.

dirpath

Directory where checkpoint files are written.

Type:

str

save_model_frequency

Epoch interval for periodic snapshots.

Type:

int

on_epoch_fi(logs_dict, model, epoch, **kwargs)[source]

Save LAST checkpoint and a numbered snapshot every N epochs.

on_train_fi(model, **kwargs)[source]

Save the final FI checkpoint when training completes.
